steps: Create a new experiment from the Blank template and save it under a new user-owned filename.
Set SessionProc timeline to Welcome, PracticeList, FormalBlockList, Goodbye.
Create PracticeTrialProc, BlockProc, and FormalTrialProc from procedure_map.csv.
Create each List as Embedded; import or paste its TSV rows and set Order from bundle_manifest.json.
Set every List Procedure column to the exact Proc name; do not place one Proc directly on another Proc timeline.
Paste inline/set_trial_identity.ebs into both SetTrialIdentity InLine objects.
Configure Stimulus objects to display [Stimulus], accept f/j, and score against [CorrectAnswer].
Enable procedure-level logging and confirm the fields in event_log_schema.json are present.
Generate the .ebs3 file, run a nonparticipant smoke session, export field names, and record hashes before changing runtime_state.
build_gate: Do not replace timing placeholders or claim paper fidelity without a source-ledger entry.
